fieldValues.title: B6. Review and land
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
Aim: a verified change merged and spread to every consumer; closed means landed.

Tried: the quorum comment, pr-upkeep, gate labels, merge rights by mode and door (949ae72d), programme auto-merge (c373c2c1), the revision-bump choreography, a8e833f1.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Trade-off: reviewable ↔ fast. Practice leaned to the human at merge; rulings now lean to automation (srs-programme: 156 auto-merges, 23 owner merges).
- Gone wrong: the owner the recorded merger of all 254 PRs in the week to 10-23; clerk 10-09 to 10-24: 41 owner-merge PRs, 40 without a gate label, 6 auto-merge; srs#962 merged over a reject verdict; false closes (srs-rust#131, srs-web#173, finding 24da1465); early epic closes (srs#256); RFC-051/052: 45 PRs, 9 repos, about 14 rulings, 3.5 of 69 hours rollout.
